findings.description: Critical: All round-2 blocking issues have been properly addressed. Lifecycle maintenance now bypasses unchanged reuse and rebuilds before SENSE, ensuring terminal pruning doesn't leave stale digests.
findings.resolution: Verified fixed in design.md D1 and spec.md scenarios

findings.description: Critical: Staleness derivation now properly defined using Git commit timestamps for tracked artifacts, with clear null/degraded behavior for untracked/modified artifacts.
findings.resolution: Fixed in design.md D2 and spec.md requirements

findings.description: Critical: Refiner priority contract inconsistency resolved. Explicit priority and insertion position are now correctly specified as independent concepts.
findings.resolution: Removed conflicting claims in proposal.md and aligned spec

findings.description: Critical: Oversized stub handling now properly defined with complete canonical manifest bounding and pre-dispatch failure with `oversized:<stub_key>` reporting.
findings.resolution: Implemented in spec.md and design.md D8

findings.description: Critical: Multi-batch and ready-frontier instructions properly replaced with single-manifest protocol and strict all-status index requirements.
findings.resolution: Updated in design.md D2 and spec.md dependency readiness sections

findings.description: Critical: Cached scored_at vs maintenance as_of conflict resolved with proper separation of generated_at for cache validation and state_updated_at for lifecycle rebuilds.
findings.resolution: Schema updated in digest.schema.json and behavior specified in design.md D6

findings.description: Critical: Multi-file publication and failure retry fully specified with durable roll-forward journal, digest-last commit marker, and startup recovery protocols.
findings.resolution: Implemented in spec.md and design.md D8

findings.description: Nit: Full ranking policy now properly exposed in digest.json schema with complete weights specification including penalty caps, risk direction, bucket orders, and tie-breakers.
Nit: prov: key support now properly handled in digest schema with nullable suggested_change_id to accommodate prov: keys that don't have change IDs.
findings.resolution: Schema updated to allow null suggested_change_id

findings.description: FYI: Dry-run behavior now properly reconciled with pre-fingerprint maintenance pass, with maintenance results computed but not persisted under dry-run.
findings.resolution: Specified in design.md D1 and spec.md dry-run behavior
